coachProgs.name: Financial coaching
coachProgs.tag: Clarity and control over your money, your investments and what you leave behind.
coachProgs.intro: Most people don’t have a money problem. They have a planning problem. Their income has grown faster than their financial knowledge, and nobody has sat down with them to build a plan that fits their real life. Financial coaching gives you that thinking partner: practical, jargon-free and always honest about the numbers.
coachProgs.forWho: Early-to-mid career professionals, founders and business owners who earn well but want a clear plan for their money, their family and their future.

areas.title: Financial planning
areas.tag: From “where does the money go?” to a plan you actually follow.
areas.quote: I earn well. I work hard. But I genuinely don’t know where all the money goes, or whether I’m doing the right things with what I have.
areas.intro: We build the foundation: a clear picture of where you stand today, a budget that fits your real life, and a step-by-step path to the goals that matter to you.
stuck: No written financial plan
Decisions get made reactively, not strategically, and money is left on the table.
Income growing, clarity shrinking
As earnings rise, so does complexity, and it is hard to keep up without a guide.
Living month to month
Not because of low income, but because there is no structured budget or spending framework.
Saving without a strategy
Money is saved towards no specific goal, so it never feels like enough.
Debt without a roadmap
Loans and obligations pile up with no clear plan to clear them.
offer: Financial health assessment
An honest look at your income, spending, savings, debts and obligations. Not a judgement, just a clear starting point.
Personal budget design
A realistic monthly framework for essentials, goals, savings and lifestyle, simple enough to follow. For founders, we also separate personal money from business money.
Goal mapping
What do you want your money to do in one, five and ten years? A home, a business, your children’s education: we map a realistic path to each.
Debt repayment strategy
A structured plan that tackles debt in the smartest order, cuts the interest you pay and frees up income.
Emergency fund
A cushion for life’s surprises, so one unexpected bill no longer derails your plans.
Accountability and review
Optional monthly check-ins to review progress and adjust the plan as your life changes.
change: A personal budget you follow consistently
Saving every month towards named goals
A clear repayment order and monthly targets
Three to six months of essential costs set aside
Informed, intentional and at ease with money

Your income, obligations, time horizon, goals and genuine risk tolerance. Everything else is built on this.

coachProgs.name: Leadership coaching
coachProgs.tag: Grow from doing the work well to leading the people, the strategy and the room.
coachProgs.intro: Most people are promoted, or start a business, because they are good at the work. coachFaq: Is the discovery call really free?
Yes. It is a relaxed 30-minute conversation about where you are and what you want to change. If it doesn’t feel like the right fit, or the timing isn’t right, there is no invoice and no obligation.
What is the difference between coaching and mentoring?

Coaching helps you find your own answers, with structure and accountability. Mentoring gives you the benefit of Awele’s experience: what he has seen work, and fail, as an accountant, banker, executive and founder. Most engagements blend both.

Every engagement is shaped around you, so fees for Foundations, Accelerator and Partnership are agreed after your discovery call, once we both understand what you need. If you would rather start small, you can book a single paid session under Book a session.
By video call, usually fortnightly or monthly. Your joining link is emailed before each session.
Yes. What you share in coaching stays between you and your coach. Financial details and workplace situations are never discussed with anyone else without your permission.
Will I be sold insurance or investment products?

No. Financial coaching is about understanding your options and making your own decisions. You choose your provider. Where you need regulated advice or formal legal drafting, such as a will or trust deed, we connect you with qualified professionals.
Can my company book coaching for me or my team?

Yes. Leadership coaching works for individuals, for managers developing their teams and for senior leaders. Mention your organisation when you request a discovery call and we will shape the engagement with you.
